text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without having reached her Awakening,
Meisho Doto continued to put in effort day after day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is continuing her activities like this truly what's best for her?
A decision must be made soon.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, quietly...
There's nobody here, right?
I'll just quietly say goodbye...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I already know... what the outcome will be. I've caused so, so much trouble ever since my debut, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for everything.
I was really happy that you were so kind to me.
From now on... I have to do my best on my own.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: "Did I forget anything? I put the leftover snacks and the picture frame in my bag, and then..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah!? Trainer-san... and Fukukitaru-san?
choice_data_list: Where are you headed with that luggage?
Where are you going with your luggage?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
No, um... you don't need me anymore,
do you? So, well...
choice_data_list: Let's keep giving it our all from here on!
Let's keep doing our best from now on!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Wait, 'from now on too' means...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeehhk!
Is it really okay for me to stay here~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Doto-san!
You've been steadily accumulating good karma, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The gods are watching ve~ry closely!
And of course, so is Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: You really held your ground, huh.
You really held your ground, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeees, yes, thank you sooo much~~~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for not giving up on a clumsy girl like me.
Starting tomorrow, I'll work even harder, waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training resumed the next day. The change—
gradually began to make itself visible.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Teiyaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Dadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, how did I do?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a completely transformed form!
Th-This... feels like an omen of great things!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hasn't it finally arrived!?
You know, that thing—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The time for "Deification" is upon us!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
The Awakening...? Has my body
finally started getting stronger...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, lately my body feels a bit lighter than before...
Maybe I can push myself even harder than I used to.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If so, our next goal is...
choice_data_list: Wanna give the Derby a shot?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeehk, the Derbyyyyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: G-G-G-Graded race?! Forget that, it's the scariest GⅠ race of all!????

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-If you tell me to do it, I'm all for itttt!
I've definitely hit my peak... I should have, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa, hyobeebee~?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Kyuu~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaah, Doto-san, hang in there~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Overwhelmed by hype and confusion, she collapsed.
As expected, setting a GⅠ as a goal
seems to still be premature."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Fwehhh, I'm so sorry~~~.
choice_data_list: Let's build up a bit more of a track record first.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees~.
Panicking over something like this...
I guess I still have a long way to go~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I think we have a pretty good shot.
Now if only some spirited deity would come possess me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her body is showing signs of growth. But her mind hasn't caught up.
Let's be patient here and take it one steady step at a time.
